posts.title: Show the model less: three wrong measurements and the one version that worked
posts.summary: Progressive disclosure was supposed to make a browser agent cheaper. Each time I fixed how I measured success a conclusion reversed, and the method itself ended up earning nothing. Then the same idea applied one level down — dropping a link attribute the agent never reads — cut tokens 22% with the only confidence interval in the project that excludes zero.
